text:
Zoe Chen: Hey team — first week and I'm setting up observability for my feature. Need view+edit on Grafana folder `prod-llm`, Sentry access to project `redwood-inference-prod` with release permissions, and Datadog logs/index read+live-tail for `llm-prod`. Who should I ping or fastest way to get these? :wave:

DevEx Bot: Hi Zoe! Please open an Observability access request at https://internal.redwood.io/obs-requests and include the items below. Quick checklist: 1) Grafana folder + role, 2) Sentry project/team + role, 3) Datadog index or API scope. If you paste what you need I can prefill the form. :robot_face:

Zoe Chen: Thanks — can you prefill? Grafana: folder `prod-llm` -> Editor. Sentry: project `redwood-inference-prod` -> Member with 'Release' permissions (need to create releases manually). Datadog: Logs index `llm-prod` -> Read + Live Tail. Prefer access ASAP for pairing tomorrow.

DevEx Bot: Got it. Creating ticket...

DevEx Bot: OBS-4281 created — https://internal.redwood.io/tickets/OBS-4281. ETA for approvals ~ 1 business day. Ping @infra-oncall if this is blocking tomorrow and we can try to fast-track.

infra-oncall: @Zoe Chen I can expedite the Grafana change. We manage folder perms via our infra tooling — I'll add you to the `prod-llm` group now. Expect ~1-2 hours. For Sentry, you'll need to be added to the `llm-engineering` team — @Priya N. can add you.

Priya N.: I can add you to Sentry. Quick question: do you need UI release creation (manual) or also CI/automated release tokens? Manual UI + release button is fine to start.

Zoe Chen: Manual UI releases only for now — manual testing during rollout. I don't have any CI tokens. Will that block the manual flow?

Priya N.: No, manual releases work fine without CI tokens. Adding you now...

Priya N.: Done — added Zoe Chen to `llm-engineering` with member + release permissions.

Priya N.: @DevEx Bot please log Sentry action in OBS-4281.

DevEx Bot: Logged in OBS-4281: Sentry addition by Priya N.

infra-oncall: Grafana change applied — you should now have Editor on `prod-llm`. If dashboards still 403, try logging out/in or clearing SSO cookies. If that fails, paste the URL and I'll check folder-level ACLs. Example internal CLI we use (thin wrapper):
```sh
grafana-cli folders grant --folder prod-llm --user zoe.chen --role Editor
```

Zoe Chen: I can see the folder, thank you! One dashboard I'm missing: `llm-serving-latency` — trying to open it gives 403.

infra-oncall: That dashboard might live in `shared-ops` with different perms. Try relogging first; if still 403 send the exact URL. Also make sure you're on the corp VPN or SSO is not blocked.

Zoe Chen: URL: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/llm-serving-latency/llm-serving-latency?orgId=1 — still 403 after relog. :disappointed:

Ravi Patel: Looks like `llm-serving-latency` is in `shared-ops`. I can copy it into `prod-llm` and update variables. Quick copy script: 
```python
# internal helper to clone dashboards between folders
copy_dashboard.py --src slugs/llm-serving-latency --dest-folder prod-llm --vars env=prod
```
I'll run that and share the new link.

Zoe Chen: Amazing, thanks both — appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:

DevEx Bot: OBS-4281 updated: Grafana Editor added, Sentry member added by Priya, Datadog request pending. Ticket: https://internal.redwood.io/tickets/OBS-4281.

infra-oncall: For Datadog logs/index access we require index owner approval — I've flagged the request to the logs team. ETA EOD; if you need queries immediately we can grant temporary read via service role, but that requires an approval exception.

Zoe Chen: If possible please grant temp read — would help for debugging today.

infra-oncall: Done — temporary read+live-tail granted for 8 hours. Confirm you can query `llm-prod` now and I'll close the exception.

Zoe Chen: Can query logs now, everything looks good. Thanks again everyone!

DevEx Bot: OBS-4281 will remain open until we finalize Datadog index ownership and remove the exception. Closing notes added. :white_check_mark:
